title: Primary Stripe Usage
slide_intent: Control enlargement so an abstract motif keeps enough of its structure for people to recognize what it represents.
strategic_value: Retaining the Whopper cross-section can keep cropped Burger King stripe graphics tied to the product.
demonstration: Two tall stripe crops labeled Minimum and Maximum are joined by a horizontal double arrow, showing a fuller cross-section and a tighter enlargement.
practical_value: Use the illustrated crop range to assess recognition when enlarging the primary stripes; do not invent a numeric zoom limit.

content_islands.name: Usage guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the explanation about retaining the Whopper cross-section at left.

content_islands.name: Minimum crop
content_islands.spec: Show the more complete stripe cross-section in the first tall frame.

content_islands.name: Maximum crop
content_islands.spec: Place the enlarged crop at right and connect the examples with a two-headed arrow.

reference_purposes.Intent: The copy explains that excessive zoom loses recognition of the Whopper cross-section.
reference_purposes.Application: Minimum and Maximum examples demonstrate the qualitative enlargement range.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The instruction limits enlargement by retained recognition; no numeric zoom percentage is supplied.

ingredient.name: Primary stripe crop
ingredient.role: Keep the food cross-section recognizable at different scales.
ingredient.application: Retain the Whopper cross-section when enlarging the stripes; compare against the shown minimum and maximum examples.
ingredient.scope: Applies to primary illustration stripes in this historical guide; the range is visual, not numeric.
